summary.en: The map shows Earth. Its points mark launch centres, not the Moon.
summary.zh: 图上是地球。点代表发射中心，不代表月球。

detail.en: The three launch-centre points stay visible for reference. Their dates do not tell us when the centres opened. Modern coastlines help locate places; no national borders are shown.
detail.zh: 三座发射中心始终显示，方便定位，日期并非它们开始运作的时间。现代海岸帮助辨认地点，图中没有国界。

title.en: Two programmes in the Cold War

summary.en: The United States and Soviet Union invest in rockets during the Cold War.
summary.zh: 冷战时期，美国和苏联都投入火箭技术。

summary.en: Mittelwerk used forced labour to produce the V-2 rockets that von Braun helped develop.
summary.zh: 米特尔工厂使用强迫劳动，生产冯·布劳恩参与研制的 V-2 火箭。

detail.en: During the Second World War, von Braun worked on Germany’s V-2 rocket. Its production at Mittelwerk used forced labour.
detail.zh: 第二次世界大战期间，冯·布劳恩参与德国 V-2 火箭工作，米特尔工厂的生产使用强迫劳动。

summary.en: Korolev was imprisoned before he later led Soviet space development.
summary.zh: 科罗廖夫早年被囚，后来才领导航天发展。

detail.en: During Stalin’s purges, Korolev was imprisoned and worked in the Soviet prison system. He later led Soviet space development.
detail.zh: 科罗廖夫在斯大林清洗中被囚，曾在苏联监狱体系内工作，后来领导航天发展。

summary.en: Plans describe intentions, flight records describe results, and memoirs preserve memories.
summary.zh: 计划书说明打算，飞行记录说明结果，回忆录留下记忆。

summary.en: Sputnik 1 becomes the first artificial satellite to orbit Earth.
summary.zh: 斯普特尼克1号成为第一颗环绕地球的人造卫星。

title.zh: 斯普特尼克2号上的莱卡

summary.en: Sputnik 2 carries Laika without a return system. She dies during the flight.
summary.zh: 斯普特尼克2号带着莱卡飞行，没有返回系统；她在飞行中死去。

summary.en: Explorer 1 is the first US satellite; Florida’s launch date is 31 January.
summary.zh: 探险者1号是美国第一颗卫星；佛罗里达当地发射日是1月31日。

detail.en: Explorer 1 launched on 31 January 1958 in Florida; in UTC it was already 1 February. Its detector helped discover Earth’s radiation belts.
detail.zh: 探险者1号在佛罗里达发射时是 1958 年 1 月 31 日，UTC 已是 2 月 1 日。探测仪帮助发现地球辐射带。

summary.en: NASA begins operations after Explorer 1 has already flown.
summary.zh: NASA 开始运作时，探险者1号已经飞行。

title.zh: 早期月球号的三种成果

summary.en: In 1959, Luna 1 flies past the Moon, Luna 2 hits it and Luna 3 photographs its far side.
summary.zh: 1959 年，月球1号飞越月球，2号撞击月面，3号拍摄背面。

detail.en: By 7 October 1959, Luna 1 had flown past the Moon, Luna 2 had struck the surface and Luna 3 had photographed the far side. These happened on different days.
detail.zh: 到 1959 年 10 月 7 日，月球1号已飞越月球，2号已撞击月面，3号已拍摄背面。这些成果发生在不同日期。

summary.en: Gagarin orbits Earth in Vostok 1, the first human spaceflight.
summary.zh: 加加林乘东方1号绕地球飞行，完成人类首次太空飞行。

summary.en: Shepard reaches space on a suborbital flight; he does not circle Earth.
summary.zh: 谢泼德完成亚轨道太空飞行，没有绕地球一周。

title.en: A Moon landing and a safe return
title.zh: 登月与安全返回的目标

summary.en: Kennedy proposes landing a person on the Moon and bringing that person safely back.
summary.zh: 肯尼迪提出让人登月，并把人安全带回地球的目标。

title.zh: 格伦与捷列什科娃的轨道飞行

summary.en: After Glenn’s US orbital flight, Tereshkova becomes the first woman in space.
summary.zh: 格伦完成美国首次载人轨道飞行之后，捷列什科娃成为首位进入太空的女性。

detail.en: John Glenn made the first US human orbital flight on 20 February 1962. Valentina Tereshkova became the first woman in space aboard Vostok 6 on 16 June 1963.
detail.zh: 约翰·格伦于 1962 年 2 月 20 日完成美国首次载人轨道飞行。瓦莲京娜·捷列什科娃于 1963 年 6 月 16 日乘东方6号，成为首位进入太空的女性。

summary.en: Voskhod expands crew flight; Leonov then makes the first spacewalk.
summary.zh: 上升号扩展了多人飞行；随后列昂诺夫完成首次太空行走。

summary.en: Gemini VI-A and VII meet in orbit without docking.
summary.zh: 双子座 VI-A 与 VII 在轨道上交会，没有对接。

summary.en: Luna 9 makes the first successful soft landing on the Moon.
summary.zh: 月球9号完成首次成功的月球软着陆。

summary.en: Gemini VIII docks with a target vehicle, then faces a thruster emergency.
summary.zh: 双子座 VIII 与目标飞行器对接，随后遇上推进器故障。

summary.en: Luna 10 becomes a lunar orbiter. Orbiting and landing are separate tasks.
summary.zh: 月球10号成为月球轨道器。绕月和着陆是不同任务。

title.zh: 美国机器人的月球勘测

summary.en: Ranger, Surveyor and Lunar Orbiter investigate the Moon before crewed landings.
summary.zh: 徘徊者、勘测者与月球轨道器在载人着陆前调查月球。

title.zh: 阿波罗1号地面测试火灾

summary.en: Three crew members—Grissom, White and Chaffee—die in the Apollo 1 ground-test fire.
summary.zh: 格里森、怀特与查菲在阿波罗1号地面测试火灾中遇难，共 3 人。

detail.en: Gus Grissom, Ed White and Roger Chaffee died on 27 January 1967. A fire broke out inside their cabin during a ground test, before launch.
detail.zh: 1967 年 1 月 27 日，阿波罗1号在发射前的地面测试中发生座舱火灾。格斯·格里森、埃德·怀特与罗杰·查菲遇难。

summary.en: Soyuz 1’s parachute system fails during return, killing its one crew member, Komarov.
summary.zh: 联盟1号返回时降落伞系统失效，唯一乘员科马罗夫遇难，共 1 人。

detail.en: Vladimir Komarov died on 24 April 1967 when Soyuz 1’s parachute system failed during return to Earth.
detail.zh: 1967 年 4 月 24 日，联盟1号返回地球时降落伞系统失效，弗拉基米尔·科马罗夫遇难。

summary.en: Uncrewed Zond 5 returns after passing around the Moon, without entering lunar orbit.
summary.zh: 无人驾驶的探测器5号绕过月球后返回，没有进入月球轨道。

detail.en: Zond 5 carried biological specimens around the Moon and back to Earth without a human crew. It followed a return path rather than staying in lunar orbit.
detail.zh: 探测器5号没有载人，它把生物标本带到月球附近，再绕过月球返回地球，没有留在月球轨道。

title.zh: 阿波罗8号进入月球轨道

summary.en: Apollo 8 carries people into lunar orbit without a lunar module.
summary.zh: 阿波罗8号把人送入月球轨道，没有携带登月舱。

title.zh: N1 与阿波罗的验证试飞

summary.en: The first N1 test has failed; Apollo 9 and 10 test the lander before a landing attempt.
summary.zh: N1首次测试已经失败；阿波罗9号与10号在着陆尝试前验证登月舱。

summary.en: Apollo 11 launches with Armstrong, Collins and Aldrin aboard.
summary.zh: 阿波罗11号载着阿姆斯特朗、柯林斯与奥尔德林发射。

summary.en: The command and service modules turn, dock and extract the lunar module.
summary.zh: 指令舱与服务舱转身，对接并抽出登月舱。

summary.en: Eagle lands at 20:17 UTC. Collins remains in lunar orbit.
summary.zh: 鹰号于 UTC 20:17 着陆；柯林斯留在月球轨道。

detail.en: The mission summary records touchdown at 20:17:39 UTC on 20 July 1969. Singapore then used UTC+07:30: about 03:47 on 21 July. Collins stayed in lunar orbit; Armstrong and Aldrin landed.
detail.zh: 任务汇总记录着陆时刻为1969年7月20日20:17:39 UTC。新加坡当时用 UTC+07:30，即7月21日约03:47。柯林斯留在月球轨道，阿姆斯特朗与奥尔德林着陆。

summary.en: The first step is at 02:56 UTC. The crew collects samples; Luna 15 crashes that day.
summary.zh: 首次踏足是 UTC 02:56。乘员采集标本；月球15号当天坠毁。

detail.en: Armstrong stepped onto the Moon at about 02:56 UTC on 21 July: about 10:26 in Singapore at UTC+07:30. Luna 15 crashed that day while attempting robotic sample return. The programmes had exchanged flight-path information to avoid interference.
detail.zh: 阿姆斯特朗首次踏足月面约为 7 月 21 日 02:56 UTC。按新加坡当时的 UTC+07:30，约为 10:26。月球15号当天在无人采样返回尝试中坠毁。双方曾交换飞行路径资料，以避免干扰。

summary.en: All three return to Earth in the command module, carrying about 22 kg of lunar samples.
summary.zh: 三人乘指令舱返回地球，带回约22千克月球标本。

detail.en: Apollo 11 brought back 21.55 kg of lunar material: about 22 kg, or 20 kg with coarser rounding. Eagle stayed on the surface for about 21 hours 36 minutes, including time inside the lander as well as the moonwalk. Only the command module carried the crew back through Earth’s atmosphere.
detail.zh: 阿波罗11号带回 21.55 千克月球材料，约为 22 千克；更粗略取整则为 20 千克。鹰号在月面停留约 21 小时 36 分钟，包括舱内停留和太空行走。只有指令舱载着乘员重返地球大气层。

summary.en: Apollo 13 does not land on the Moon; its crew returns alive.
summary.zh: 阿波罗13号没有登月，乘组生还返回。

summary.en: Luna 16 brings lunar samples back without a human crew.
summary.zh: 月球16号在没有载人乘组的情况下带回月球标本。

summary.en: Lunokhod 1 explores on eight wheels, controlled from Earth.
summary.zh: 月球车1号用八个车轮探测月面，由地球遥控。

summary.en: After working on Salyut 1, Dobrovolski, Volkov and Patsayev die when Soyuz 11 loses cabin pressure.
summary.zh: 多布罗沃尔斯基、沃尔科夫与帕察耶夫在礼炮1号工作后，因联盟11号失压遇难。

detail.en: Georgi Dobrovolski, Vladislav Volkov and Viktor Patsayev lived and worked on Salyut 1. They died on 30 June 1971 when Soyuz 11 lost cabin pressure in space during their return.
detail.zh: 格奥尔基·多布罗沃尔斯基、弗拉季斯拉夫·沃尔科夫与维克托·帕察耶夫曾在礼炮1号生活和工作。1971 年 6 月 30 日，联盟11号在返回途中的太空失压，三人遇难。

summary.en: Six Apollo missions have landed people on the Moon. Four N1 tests have failed without crews aboard.
summary.zh: 六次阿波罗任务把人送上月面；N1四次无人测试均未成功。

summary.en: By this date, N1-L3 spending reaches 3.6 billion rubles for the lunar-landing project.
summary.zh: 截至这一天，N1-L3 载人登月项目支出为 36 亿卢布。

detail.en: Siddiqi reports N1-L3 spending of 3.6 billion rubles by 1 January 1973. Later rough totals were 4.0–4.5 billion rubles. These accounts cover the lunar-landing project, rather than all Soviet space activity. Different currencies and accounting scopes prevent a direct cost comparison with Apollo.
detail.zh: 西迪基记载，截至 1973 年 1 月 1 日，N1-L3 支出为 36 亿卢布，后来的粗略总额为 40 亿至 45 亿卢布。这些账目只包括载人登月项目。币种和费用范围不同，无法与阿波罗直接比较。

summary.en: In 1973, NASA reports Apollo’s cost as about US$25.4 billion.
summary.zh: 1973 年，NASA 报告阿波罗项目支出约为 254 亿美元。

detail.en: NASA reported US$25.4 billion in 1973. A later reconstruction gives about US$25.8 billion because it includes different costs. Both use historical dollars; the difference is not an inflation range. The report’s exact month and day are unknown.
detail.zh: NASA 在 1973 年报告支出为 254 亿美元。后来重建的账目约为 258 亿美元，所含费用范围不同。两者都使用当时美元，差额并非通胀区间。报告的确切月日不详。

summary.en: Salyut and Skylab continue orbital research after the first Moon landing.
summary.zh: 首次登月之后，礼炮号与天空实验室继续在轨道开展研究。

title.zh: 三起事故中的七名死者

summary.en: The Apollo 1, Soyuz 1 and Soyuz 11 accidents killed seven crew members in all.
summary.zh: 阿波罗1号、联盟1号与联盟11号事故，合计造成 7 名乘员死亡。

detail.en: Apollo 1: 3; Soyuz 1: 1; Soyuz 11: 3. The subtotal is seven deaths in these three accidents, rather than every death connected with spaceflight. These deaths happened earlier, not on this review date.
detail.zh: 阿波罗1号 3 人，联盟1号 1 人，联盟11号 3 人，小计 7 人。这只包括上述三起事故，未涵盖所有航天相关死亡。这些事故都发生在回顾日期之前。

summary.en: Apollo and Soyuz dock using a connecting module. The Apollo launch vehicle was a Saturn IB.
summary.zh: 阿波罗与联盟号通过连接舱对接；阿波罗使用的运载火箭是土星IB。

detail.en: Apollo and Soyuz docked in Earth orbit on 17 July 1975 through a connecting module. Apollo launched on Saturn IB, rather than Saturn V. The spacecraft had launched from Cape Canaveral and Baikonur.
detail.zh: 1975 年 7 月 17 日，阿波罗与联盟号在地球轨道通过连接舱对接。阿波罗由土星 IB 发射，并非土星五号。两艘飞船此前分别从卡纳维拉尔角与拜科努尔发射。

summary.en: 21 July 1969, about 02:56 UTC: Armstrong first steps onto the Moon; Singapore’s time was about 10:26 at UTC+07:30.
summary.zh: 1969年7月21日约02:56 UTC，阿姆斯特朗首次踏足月面；按新加坡当时UTC+07:30，约为10:26。

summary.en: 21 July 1969: Luna 15 crashes while trying to collect lunar samples and return them to Earth without a crew.
summary.zh: 1969 年 7 月 21 日：月球15号在无人采样返回尝试中坠毁。

summary.en: Baikonur is the launch centre associated with Soviet missions such as Sputnik, Vostok and Luna.
summary.zh: 拜科努尔是斯普特尼克、东方号与月球号等苏联任务的关联发射中心。

summary.en: Kennedy Space Center is the launch centre associated with Apollo 11’s journey to the Moon.
summary.zh: 肯尼迪航天中心是阿波罗11号登月旅程的关联发射中心。

summary.en: The Cape Canaveral launch area is associated with Explorer 1, Mercury and Gemini flights, and the Apollo 1 ground test.
summary.zh: 卡纳维拉尔角发射区关联探险者1号、水星与双子座飞行，以及阿波罗1号地面测试。
